scripts.dev: npm run build -w @axis/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @axis/shared" "npm run dev -w @axis/api" "npm run dev -w @axis/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @axis/shared && npm run build -w @axis/api && npm run build -w @axis/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @axis/shared && npm run typecheck -w @axis/api && npm run typecheck -w @axis/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @axis/shared && npm run test -w @axis/web && npm run test -w @axis/api
